'''Cantorin''' is one of the ''[[Atha'an Miere]]'' islands belonging to the [[Aile Somera]] group.

The harbor on Cantorin forms a wide, lopsided bowl. During the ''[[Hailene]]'', [[Suroth Sabelle Meldarath]] used Cantorin as a place to consolidate the [[Seanchan]] forces before continuing to the [[Westlands]]. {{ref/book|4|1}} The Sea Folk vessel of ''[[Wavedancer]]'' trades between the islands of Cantorin, [[Dantora]] and the [[Aile Jafar]] group. {{ref/book|4|39}}{{ref/book|4|46}} [[Egeanin Tamarath]] and [[Bayle Domon]] sail to Cantorin on the ''[[Spray]]'', where they are boarded by Seanchan forces.{{ref/book|9|21}} While there, Egeanin purchases a ''[[damane]]'' named [[Serrisa]].{{ref/book|10|21}}
